title: About 3 weeks ago, I started creating Rustl-Volt: a Re-Volt remake in my own game engine
author: Bastl34
selftext:
I recently saw that someone created a Re-Volt-inspired game called Voltane, so I thought it would make sense to show you **Rustl-Volt** here.

It's a custom engine port of Re-Volt based on the original assets, running in my own game engine called Rustl, which I've been working on for three years now but development has recently accelerated a lot with AI.

My goal was to develop the engine so that I could create games with it, and Rustl-Volt was a good candidate to develop the engine further and create a cool port of the awesome Re-Volt game.

This port uses the original game assets, which can be sourced from the Steam version of the game or downloaded from re-volt.io.

Link: [https://github.com/Bastl34/rustl-volt](https://github.com/Bastl34/rustl-volt)

**Check out the Making-of video on YouTube:**

▶ [https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=0CBxMKopNmY](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=0CBxMKopNmY)

comments.author: Still_Explorer
comments.body:
Wow I remember this game! Such nostalgia... 😁

My favorite feature was seeing the antenna on top of the car wobbling by physics. If you add this will be cool.

replies.author: Bastl34
replies.body: Actually this feature is already in the latest build 🙂

comments.author: Historical_Lock378
comments.body: why play this instead of RVGL?

replies.author: Bastl34
replies.body: It's not meant to be a competitor to RVGL. For me, it is a project to gain more experience and enhance my own engine. Maybe check out my making-of video to see the reason for the project.

replies.author: Historical_Lock378
replies.body: Oh okay well cool man, this is one of my favorite childhood games. It's cool you chose this one in particular for your own engine.

comments.author: t1mebomb
comments.body: Really cool. I am dying for someone to do the same for Motörhead
